title: Resolve CI-watch abort after restart
description: Resolve a persisted blocked CI decision through a running gateway after its original resolver is gone. Supply a blocked run ID and a decision ID from an isolated validation gateway.

before.intent: Read the persisted blocked run through the gateway before resolving its CI decision.

blocked.intent: Require an operator-blocked run before testing the restart fallback.

abort.intent: Choose Abort through the real gateway RPC after the in-memory CI resolver was lost.

resolved.intent: Confirm the gateway persisted the operator choice.

after.intent: Read the run after the gateway re-enters its CI-watch step.

done-status.intent: Require the run to finish instead of remaining blocked.

aborted-result.intent: Require CI-watch to record Abort instead of starting another poll.
